bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Beyond this task's original 2012-2025 scope, but included because it is genuinely sourced and adds the most current available granularity for this bank. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2025. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete; the source explicitly labels this 'For the Quarter ended 31 March 2026'). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. The bank is now operating under a Bangladesh-Bank-appointed Administrator in place of a Board/Managing Director (signature block reads 'Administrator' and 'Chairman' only), consistent with insights.json. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) quality is good. MAJOR DISCREPANCY FOUND IN THE DEC-2025 COMPARATIVE (flagged, not reconciled -- 2025_Q4.json is left unmodified): this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative shows Total assets of 11,856,496,363 and Total liabilities of 26,480,395,772, both roughly BDT 3,218.24m HIGHER than 2025_Q4.json's audited FY2025 figures (total assets 8,638,258,529; total liabilities 23,262,157,938) -- the two deltas are identical to the taka (3,218,237,834), so this is a symmetric addition to both sides of the balance sheet with total Shareholders' equity completely UNCHANGED (-14,623,899,409 in both sources, an exact match). Traced to the 'Other assets' line (331m as of Sep-2025 per 2025_Q3.json, jumping to 3,545.5m in this filing's Dec-2025 and Mar-2026 columns) mirrored by a corresponding jump in 'Other liabilities' (previously ~5,700-6,000m range, now 8,308.4m Dec-2025 / 8,453.1m Mar-2026) -- consistent with a gross-up/regrossing of a suspended-profit or classified-investment-related asset-liability pair rather than any change to genuine net worth; the exact cause was not identified from this filing's own text (Notes did not explain it) and is flagged here for a future session's attention. Investments, deposits and equity are all unaffected and match 2025_Q4.json exactly. SEPARATE MINOR ERROR: this filing's own 'Total Off-Balance Sheet items' row for Dec-2025 shows a stale carried-over figure (206,990,313, actually the Dec-2024 value used in earlier quarters) that contradicts its own correctly-updated 'Contingent liabilities' breakdown for the same date (which sums to 295,216,860, confirmed by adding the four legible sub-lines) -- 295,216,860 is used here as the correct Dec-2025 comparative. Also note: the minimum-tax rate applied changed from 0.60% to 1% of gross receipts this quarter per the filing's own Note 05, a regulatory change, not a data error. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D=0 -- no provision this quarter -- PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.36, matching the filing's own Notes section). The Q1-2025 comparative NOCFPS is internally inconsistent within this same filing (the numbered Notes table prints -0.77, but this filing's own prose 'significant deviation' paragraph and its EPS/PAT comparative both point to -0.02, matching 2025_Q1.json exactly) -- -0.02 is treated as correct and -0.77 as an isolated table error.
